title: First Lessons: Ember
introNarration: Mentor Cinder keeps the hearth dummy in sight. The copper grate ticks. There is a ghost of oatcakes left too near the coals. "Look around this hearth. Smell the soot and name the fire before you feed it. Defeat the hearth dummy in this room — not Flint's orchard dummy. Then come back and talk to me. I will open this School's leaf and ink its stem in your Field Primer."
reminderNarration: Look around this hearth. Defeat the hearth dummy here. Then talk to Cinder. The grate is still warm, and she is still waiting.
completionNarration: Cinder inks the stem at rank I. The Primer smells faintly of smoke and new ink. The next lesson will ask you to cast.

objectives.label: Return and talk to Mentor Cinder.
